title: PR #142: Idempotent Webhook Ingestion & Lease Recovery

overview.tldr: Saves each webhook ID in Postgres before running it so retried callbacks from Stripe or GitHub never run twice.
overview.global_context: External providers send webhooks to `webhookRouter`, which calls `WebhookDispatcher` directly inside the HTTP request.
overview.before_state: Every retry ran `WebhookDispatcher` again and could charge a customer twice.
overview.after_state: `webhookRouter` claims `(provider, event_id)` in `PostgresIdempotencyStore` first and skips duplicates with `200 OK`.

concepts.what_it_is: Central service that routes verified webhook payloads to domain handlers like billing and repo sync.
how_it_works: **Execution model:** Runs synchronously inside the `POST /webhooks/:provider` HTTP request with no background queue.
**Failure behavior:** Throws when a downstream handler fails so Express returns `500` and the sender retries later.
**Caller contract:** Expects signature verification and deduplication to happen before `dispatch()` is called.
concepts.pr_impact: Its own code does not change, but `webhookRouter` now skips calling it whenever `PostgresIdempotencyStore` says the event already ran.

concepts.what_it_is: Express router that receives `POST /webhooks/:provider` callbacks from external payment and git providers.
how_it_works: **Event ID lookup:** Reads `x-webhook-id` from HTTP headers first and falls back to `req.body.id`.
**Error middleware:** Uncaught errors bubble into `webhookErrorHandler` at the bottom of the same file.
concepts.pr_impact: Now rejects missing event IDs with `400`, checks `PostgresIdempotencyStore` before dispatch, and frees the lease if dispatch throws.

concepts.what_it_is: PostgreSQL-backed lock table that tracks whether a `(provider, event_id)` pair is running or finished.
how_it_works: **Single round-trip claim:** Uses `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` so checking and locking happen in one atomic SQL query.
**Crash recovery:** Holds a 60-second `CLAIMED` lease so another worker can take over if the first worker crashes mid-request.
concepts.pr_impact: Brand-new module introduced in PR 1 and wired into the HTTP route in PR 2.

chapters.title: Webhook Guard & UI

steps.title: SQL lease table and TypeScript contract
steps.explanation: Defines `webhook_idempotency_keys` and the `IdempotencyStore` types before any query logic uses them.

rows: A worker is running this webhook right now until `lease_expires_at`.
The webhook finished and all future retries must skip it.

steps.title: Atomic claim query and 60s crash recovery
steps.explanation: Writes the first version of `PostgresIdempotencyStore` with `claimOrSkip()` so only one worker wins each event.

points.text: `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` steals an existing row only when `status = 'CLAIMED'` and its 60s lease expired.
When Postgres returns zero rows, another worker owns or finished the event, so we return `SKIP_IN_FLIGHT_OR_DONE`.

callouts.text: The `catch` block returns `PROCESS` when Postgres fails (`store.ts` L29)—check whether billing webhooks must fail with `500` instead.
`lease_expires_at` uses app `Date.now()` (`L14`) while conflict checks use DB `NOW()` (`L22`), which can drift if clocks differ.

steps.title: Add completion and rollback methods to the store
steps.explanation: Extends `PostgresIdempotencyStore` with `markCompleted()` and `releaseClaim()` so the HTTP route can finish or undo a claim.

rows: Row stays `COMPLETED` forever so retries skip it.
Deletes the `CLAIMED` row so the next retry can run.

steps.title: Wrap /webhooks/:provider with the dedup guard
steps.explanation: Registers `PostgresIdempotencyStore` in the container and guards `WebhookDispatcher` inside `webhookRouter`.

visuals.caption: Even though this PR only changes backend SQL and Express code, here is the Admin Console it powers: duplicate retries return `200 deduplicated` (top right) while active runs hold a 60s `CLAIMED` lease.

callouts.text: If `releaseClaim()` throws during a DB outage inside `catch` (`webhooks.ts` L34), it hides the original error from `WebhookDispatcher`.

steps.title: Audit unit tests (catches a broken mock test)
steps.explanation: Checks duplicate skipping and expired-lease recovery against a mocked `db.query` function.

callouts.text: Bug in `webhook-dedup.test.ts` L7–14: the mock returns a row, so `store.ts` returns `PROCESS` instead of `SKIP_ALREADY_PROCESSED`.

untested_gaps: Mocks `db.query`, so the real Postgres `ON CONFLICT` SQL never runs.
No route test checks missing `eventId` (`400`) or `releaseClaim()` when `WebhookDispatcher` throws.
